compliance.title: Official alerts help you decide what to review.
compliance.p1: The EU Safety Gate system shares alerts about dangerous non-food products. The General Product Safety Regulation applies to businesses selling consumer products in the EU.
compliance.p2: A Safety Gate alert can be a useful signal for a merchant to compare product identifiers, photos and batches. Requirements and corrective steps depend on the product and the country.
compliance.p3: Safety Gate Monitor helps organize possible matches and review decisions. It does not make a legal determination or change product status for you.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is the EU Safety Gate (formerly RAPEX)?
faq.a1: EU Safety Gate is the European Union's rapid alert system for dangerous non-food consumer products. It alerts member states and consumers about hazardous toys, electronics, cosmetics, and equipment subject to recalls.
faq.q2: Why is this more than a one-off AI search?
faq.a2: Products can be renamed or photographed differently, and new Safety Gate alerts are published over time. The app combines catalog comparison, ongoing updates, a review queue and a record of merchant decisions.
faq.q3: Does this app modify or unpublish my Shopify products automatically?
faq.a3: No. Safety Gate Monitor is strictly advisory and operates under read-only catalog access. It flags potential risks and creates actionable review alerts in your Shopify Admin, leaving all publishing decisions entirely under your control.
faq.q4: What is included in the free scan?
faq.a4: We check up to 100 publicly accessible Shopify products against Safety Gate alerts and email a summary of possible matches. It does not cover private or password-protected listings and is not a certificate of safety.

about.metaTitle: About Safety Gate Monitor – Product Safety Monitoring for Shopify
about.metaDescription: Why Safety Gate Monitor exists, how it helps Shopify merchants review potential product-safety matches, and the principles behind the product.
about.title: Built so Shopify merchants can stop wondering what they might have missed.
about.subtitle: Safety Gate Monitor turns official EU product-safety alerts into a clear Shopify workflow—giving your team confidence when action is needed and peace of mind when it is not.
about.missionTitle: Why we built Safety Gate Monitor
about.missionP1: A recalled product may appear under a different name, brand, package, or supplier listing. That makes manual checks slow and easy to miss—especially as a catalog grows.
about.missionP2: We built Safety Gate Monitor to continuously compare Shopify catalogs with the EU Safety Gate system, surface likely matches, and give merchants a practical place to review and document each decision.
about.missionP3: The goal is not to replace professional judgement. It is to make reliable evidence easier to find, the next action easier to take, and the quiet periods genuinely reassuring.
about.principle1Body: Monitoring is grounded in product-safety alerts published through the European Commission’s Safety Gate system.
about.principle2Body: The app highlights potential matches and supporting evidence. It does not automatically unpublish products or make the final decision for you.
about.principle3Body: Reviews, resolutions, and dismissals are recorded so your team can understand what was checked and what happened next.
about.scopeTitle: What Safety Gate Monitor is—and what it is not.
about.scopeBody: Safety Gate Monitor is independent software for Shopify merchants. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the European Commission, EU Safety Gate, or Shopify. Potential matches are decision support, not a legal determination or legal advice.
about.scopeLink: Visit the official EU Safety Gate portal ↗
about.ctaTitle: Know what needs attention—and enjoy the quiet when nothing does.
about.ctaSubtitle: Start with a free catalog scan. We will surface potential matches clearly and leave the final decision with you.
about.contactTitle: A real person behind the product.
about.contactBody: Safety Gate Monitor is an independent project. If you have a question about the product, a scan or your data, write to us directly.

quiet.title: Only ask for action when a product needs review.
quiet.body: Once the app is installed, monitoring runs in the background. A likely match goes to your review queue with supporting evidence. When the preceding week has no new merchant alert, you receive a short all-clear email instead of another task.
quiet.note: All-clear means no new alerts were found in that period; it is not a guarantee that every product is safe.
